title: Daily MFI14 midline price-volume state long/cash timing
thesis: When the prior fourteen complete daily BTC typical-price money flows remain net positive enough to keep MFI above its equal-flow midline, price movement may be supported by volume strongly enough that a causal next-open long/cash policy preserves material upside while avoiding enough adverse paths to improve fee-adjusted risk-adjusted performance over full-capital buy-and-hold.
mechanism: For each complete UTC day, compute typical price from daily high, low and close, multiply by daily base volume, classify the latest fourteen raw money flows by typical-price direction using the immediately preceding day, and calculate MFI as 100 times positive flow divided by positive plus negative flow. The strategy is fully long BTC when completed-day MFI14 is strictly above a frozen threshold and otherwise holds zero-yield cash, with state changes executed at the next H1 open.
economic_rationale: MFI14 combines direction and traded volume in a bounded rolling ratio rather than using close-only RSI, cumulative OBV or close-location CMF. The mechanism is useful only if the fixed 50 equal-flow boundary retains material upside after costs while reducing drawdown and improving Calmar with broad annual and threshold-neighbor support.
